correctness.rationale: Unique Fq point fixes P. Its tangent has divisor (s+1)P, forcing abstract automorphisms to preserve the degree-one complete linear series even for s=2. A nonsingular triangular projective stabilizer has exactly the stated Frobenius-bilinear coefficient conditions, whose converse is verified by polynomial expansion. Norm-one counting and surjective trace prove order; exact matrix multiplication, commutators and invariant fields prove semidirect Heisenberg structure and degree-s³ one-branch quotient. The standalone exact checker exhausts F4 and F9 projective candidates and tests F25; the proof, not experiments, covers every prime power.

value.rationale: The single-rational-point twists of the Hermitian curve are an intrinsic distinguished family in finite-field algebraic geometry; their entire arithmetic automorphism group (including small genus-one case) and nonabelian p-Sylow structure determine a natural wild Galois quotient of degree s³ ramified at one point. This is stronger and more structurally useful than routine point counting or a finite table and supplies exact symmetry and covering data for future arithmetic/ramification work.
